question: Game 7 of the 2016 World Series, Nov. 2: Cubs and Indians tied 6-6 after nine, then rain stopped play and Jason Heyward called a players-only meeting. How long was that famous rain delay?
question_short: Cubs-Indians Game 7, tied 6-6 after nine. Rain stops play. How long was the delay?
answer_detail: Heyward rallied teammates in a weight room during the short break. Chicago then scored twice in the 10th, held on 8-7 and ended a 108-year title drought.
answer_short: Heyward's weight-room speech, then two Cubs runs in the 10th ended a 108-year drought.
